title: LPCO Base Information Package — codex
description: Details related to Licenses, Permits, Certificates or Others.

actual.description: Date and time when this authentication was actually signed or otherwise authenticated.

authentication.description: Statement providing proof that the document has been authenicated.

name.description: Name of the party which certifies that a document is authentic.

identification.description: Identification of a party which certifies that a document is authentic.
identification.x-wco-code-list: International codes (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User codes

role.description: Code specifying the role of a party.

items.description: Details related to an authenticating party.
Details related to the authentication of a document.

statement.description: Code specifying the form of an additional statement.

statementType.description: Code specifying the subject of the additional statement.

items.description: Details related to the special request from declarant to government to take or not to take action.

totalPackage.description: Quantity specifying the total number of packages of the entire document (e.g. declaration/consignment).

boarded.description: Quantity specifying the total number shown on bill of lading or on split shipment. It will be the actual number of pieces boarded on the conveyance. (Not necessarily the smallest external packaging unit for the shipment).

name.description: Name to identify the means of transport used for the carriage of the goods in crossing the border.

identification.description: Identification of the means of transport used in crossing the border.
identification.x-wco-code-list:
Sea: ITU Standard or Lloyd's number
Air: IATA aircraft ID
Road: national license plate
Rail: locomotive number

type.description: Code specifying type of means of transport used for the carriage of the goods in crossing the border.

identification.description: Identification of the arrival location. This would be a port for sea, airport for air and border post for land crossing.
identification.x-wco-code-list: UN/LOCODE + User codes OR User codes

items.description: Details related to the first arrival location.
Details related to the means of transport crossing the border of the Customs territory.

name.description: Name of the party to which goods are consigned.

identification.description: Identification of a party to which goods are consigned.
identification.x-wco-code-list: International codes (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User codes

role.description: Code specifying the role of a party.

items.description: Details related to the party to which goods are consigned.

sequence.description: Number indicating the position in a sequence.
Number indicating the position in a sequence.

description.description: Description of the nature of a goods item sufficient to identify it for cross-border regulatory purposes such as customs, phytosanitary, statistical or transport.

lotNumber.description: Identification of the production lot by number.

intendedUseStatement.description: Statement regarding the intended use of the commodity.

intendedUse.description: Code specifying the intended use of the commodity.

name.description: Name of the location of a facility approved for a specific purpose by a government authority.

identification.description: Identification of a facility approved for a specific purpose by a government authority.
identification.x-wco-code-list: UN/LOCODE + User codes OR User codes

items.description: Details related to a facility approved for a specific purpose by a government authority.

identification.description: Identification of the non-commercial categorization of a commodity by a standard-setting organization.

name.description: Code specifying the scientific name of original plant/animal used as a material for food products, medications, cosmetics, medical materials, etc.

identificationType.description: Code specifying the commodity classification  (e.g. Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS), Export Control Classification Code (ECCC), UNDG Code list, International Code of Zoological Nomenc).

items.description: Details related to the non-commercial categorization of a commodity by a standard-setting organization.

name.description: Name of the party that manufactures goods.

identification.description: Identification of a party which manufactures goods.
identification.x-wco-code-list: International codes (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User codes

role.description: Code specifying the role of a party.

items.description: Details related to the party which manufactures goods.

name.description: Name of the party or person who has produced the product.

identification.description: Identification of the party or person who has produced the product.
identification.x-wco-code-list: International codes (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User codes

role.description: Code specifying the role of a party.

items.description: Details related to the producer of the product.

description.description: Name or term that identifies the goods assigned by a seller as distinct from those of other sellers, in legal terms known as trademark, which helps to identify one item, a family of items, or all items of that seller.

qualifier.description: Code specifying the commodity name (e.g. common name, registered name, brand name).

items.description: Details related to the name of a product.
Details related to the properties of the goods.

country.description: Code specifying the country of destination.

countryName.description: Name of the country of destination.

items.description: Details related to the destination location.

netNetWeight.description: Weight of the goods themselves without any packing.

items.description: Details related to goods weight, quantities, and amounts.

country.description: Code specifying the country in which the goods have been produced or manufactured, according to criteria laid down for the application of the Customs tariff or quantitative restrictions, or any measure related to trade.

countryName.description: Name of the country in which the goods have been produced or manufactured, according to criteria laid down for the application of the Customs tariff or quantitative restrictions, or any measure related to trade.

region.description: Identification of the region in which the goods have been produced or manufactured, according to criteria laid down for the purposes of application of the Customs tariff, or quantitative restrictions, or of any other measure related to trade.

items.description: Details related to the origin of the goods.

sequence.description: Number indicating the position in a sequence.

quantity.description: Quantity specifying the number of individual items packaged in such a way that they cannot be divided without first undoing the packing.

type.description: Code specifying the type of package of an item.

items.description: Details related to packaging.
Details related to an item in a consignment.

name.description: Name of the party consigning goods as stipulated in the transport contract by the party ordering transport.

identification.description: Identification of  the party consigning goods as stipulated in the transport contract by the party ordering the transport.
identification.x-wco-code-list: International codes (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User codes

role.description: Code specifying the role of a party.

items.description: Details related to the party which, by contract with a carrier, consigns or sends goods with the carrier, or has them conveyed by him.

name.description: Name of the party who has provided the certification.

identification.description: Identification of a party which certifies something.
identification.x-wco-code-list: International codes (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User codes

role.description: Code specifying the role of a party.

items.description: Details related to the party which certifies something.
Details related to (governmental) examination.

name.description: Name of a seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other location at which goods are loaded onto the means of transport being used for their carriage.

identification.description: Identification of a seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other location at which goods are loaded onto the means of transport being used for their carriage.
identification.x-wco-code-list: UN/LOCODE + User codes OR User codes

items.description: Details related to the location at which the goods (i.e., consignments) are loaded on to the active means of transport.

flashpoint.description: Measure of the flashpoint temperature of dangerous goods.

category.description: Code specifying the storage condition of a commodity.

storageRequirement.description: Temperature required to be maintained for a commodity, or in a container, or in a conveyance.

minimumStorageRequirement.description: Minimum temperature required to be maintained for a commodity, or in a container, or in a conveyance.

maximumStorageRequirement.description: Maximum temperature required to be maintained for a commodity, or in a container, or in a conveyance.

items.description: Details related to temperature.

sequence.description: Number indicating the position in a sequence.

characteristic.description: Code specifying the characteristics (e.g. size and type of a piece of transport equipment).
characteristic.x-wco-code-list: ISO, IATA, EDIFACT (8053 or 8155) OR User codes

identification.description: Identification of the equipment (e.g. unit load device by marks, letters, and/or numbers).

sequence.description: Number indicating the position in a sequence.

identification.description: Identification of a seal affixed to a piece of transport equipment by number.

items.description: Details related to the seal affixed to a piece of transport equipment, used to secure an object and protect from unauthorized entry or tampering.
Details related to transport equipment used for the consignment.
Details related to the transport between a consignor and a consignee as specified in the transport contract document.

name.description: Name of the person who makes, or on whose behalf the export declaration is made, and who is the owner of the goods or has similar right of disposal over them at the time when the declaration is accepted.

identification.description: Identification of the party who makes, or on whose behalf the export declaration is made, and who is the owner of the goods or has similar rights of disposal over them at the time when the declaration is accepted.

role.description: Code specifying the role of a party.

items.description: Details related to the person/party who makes or on whose behalf an export declaration is made.

identification.description: Identification of a party who makes, or on whose behalf a customs clearing agent or other authorized person makes, an import declaration. This may include a person who has possession of the goods or to whom the goods are consigned.
identification.x-wco-code-list: International codes (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User codes

role.description: Code specifying the role of a party.

items.description: Details related to the party who makes - or on whose behalf a customs clearing agent or other authorized person makes - an import declaration.
